what: The media-kit track's candidate first batch. STAGED, NOT WIRED: nothing under public/design/ is read by any marketing surface, and marketing-media.test.ts does not scan it. These files exist so the board at /design/c/media-kit can show a candidate beside the stand-in it would replace, with its provenance under it.
license: Every file is CC0 1.0, confirmed twice before download: the Commons file page carries {{Unsplash}}, which Commons applies only to media published on Unsplash before 5 June 2017, when Unsplash's sitewide license was CC0; and the API's extmetadata reports CC0 for the file. On 5 June 2017 Unsplash replaced CC0 with its own license, which Commons does not accept.
caveat: CC0 waives copyright. It does not waive publicity or privacy rights, and Commons verifies no uploader's ownership. A frame with an identifiable face still needs a release nobody here holds. See docs/specs/media-kit.md 1.4.
resized: Each file is the Commons thumbnail of the original, resized to 1200 px wide and re-encoded for the web with all metadata stripped. CC0 permits modification without permission; the record of who made it lives here rather than in EXIF.
